code:
MONICA (CDO): Since we're in there anyway, can we just merge
              the duplicate customer records too?
YOU: That's master data management, and it's real work --
     but merging records safely means knowing, for certain,
     which fields are sensitive and who owns each source first.
     We'd be guessing. Phase 3, same engagement, right after
     quality rules.
caption: Not a no -- a sequencing decision, already on the calendar.

code:
SHIPS IN V1:
  Purview Data Map registration + scan: all 5 sources
  Critical data element inventory (customer PII fields)
  Ownership + stewardship RACI, signed by name
  Active Customer glossary term, published and approved
  Confidential – PII labels on every SSN/financial column

SEQUENCED NEXT, SAME ENGAGEMENT:
  Data quality rules and SQL checks
  Master data management (duplicate customer merge)
caption: Every deferred item has a phase and a date -- nothing is just dropped.
